6.0.3.changelog: Fix Tasks/Subtasks not being populated or updated in story files during enhanced sprint pipeline

6.0.4.changelog: Added Step 8b (Edge Case Hunter review) — runs in parallel with code review and adversarial review. Leverages new BMAD 6.0.4 review-edge-case-hunter.xml task for method-driven path enumeration.

6.2.0.changelog: Consolidated review (BMAD 6.2 runs adversarial + edge case + acceptance internally). E2E TDD step runs red-phase E2E tests in parallel with unit TDD. Updated for .claude/skills/ architecture.

6.4.0.changelog: Skill renames /bmad-bmm-* → /bmad-* (6.3.0 agent consolidation: Quinn QA, Bob SM, Barry → Amelia). Pipeline restructured 11 → 9 steps: Step 3 is now a fresh-context Opus runner that executes BMAD's bmad-create-story/checklist.md; Step 4 unit-TDD dropped (Amelia writes Kent-Beck-style unit tests inline in dev-story); Step 10 AC-trace dropped (Acceptance Auditor inside Step 7 covers it). Phase 0 epic-context cache compiled once and reused across Steps 1/5/7. New unattended-by-default behavior (only ambiguous merge conflicts pause), per-story auto-commit at Step 9 with submodule-first sequence (never auto-pushes), codebase anti-leak rules injected into Steps 5/6/8/9 (no BMAD/story-ID references in code or main-repo commits), and a deferred-decisions log artifact for every judgment call. Hotfix port: version label bumped only — Step 0 self-detection logic unchanged for 6.4 surfaces.

6.6.0.changelog: Config-source patch for BMAD 6.6 (#2348): `project_name` moved from `_bmad/bmm/config.yaml` to `_bmad/core/config.yaml`. Phase 0 step 1 and the Configuration table now reflect the two-file split (core vs bmm) and prefer the core copy when both exist (matches installer auto-migration precedence). 6.5.0 brought no script-affecting changes (agent-platform additions only); skill paths and command names verified unchanged from 6.4.0. Hotfix unchanged.

6.8.0.changelog: BMAD 6.8 support. Skill/command names verified UNCHANGED 6.6→6.8 (/bmad-create-story, /bmad-dev-story, /bmad-code-review, /bmad-qa-generate-e2e-tests, /bmad-sprint-status, /bmad-correct-course) and story-status vocabulary unchanged — no document conversion required for the pipeline's inputs (stories/epics/sprint-status/PRD all forward-compatible). 6.8 breaking changes (bmad-create-ux-design → bmad-ux two-spine DESIGN.md+EXPERIENCE.md; bmad-distillator → bmad-spec) are planning surfaces the sprint does not consume. PATH FIX: support-file reads (methods.csv, create-story checklist.md, compile-epic-context.md) now resolve through a Phase-0-detected ${BMAD_SKILLS_ROOT} (canonical .claude/skills/<skill>/, with legacy _bmad/ fallback cascade) — the old _bmad/bmm/skills/ and _bmad/core/workflows/ paths were stale since the 6.2 .claude/skills move. NEW baseline_commit handling (#2403): dev-story stamps baseline_commit into story frontmatter and code-review uses it as the diff base; Step 7 now constrains review scope to the story File List to prevent cross-story over-scoping from sibling worktree merges, and notes that yolo + baseline_commit keep code-review unattended (no branch-confirm HALT). Added project_context (#2422) to the env block (optional, skills self-resolve). .decision-log.md (6.7) confirmed planning-only — no coexistence concern. Hotfix: version label bumped to 6.8.0 only. IN-VERSION REVISION (2026-07-15, tuned from 22 stories / ~25.6M subagent tokens of harness-reported usage across three consecutive sprints): Step 1.5 classifier sonnet→haiku with slim prompt (no env block), skipped entirely on --tier=/:suffix override, lite-below-high-confidence promoted to standard; Step 9 opus→sonnet (pure git mechanics, ambiguous conflicts still hard-pause); Step 10 folded to coordinator-inline sprint-status.yaml edits with ONE /bmad-sprint-status reconcile agent at epic close-out; Step 2 elicitation input capped to description+ACs+Tasks/Subtasks+epic-context cache (Dev Notes per-subsection only); mid-epic epic-context recompile after every 3rd completed story; Step 7 review liveness protocol (SendMessage nudge before respawn, collect late child-hunter findings before Step 9 commits); Model assignments rationalized: Step 5 standardized on opus across all surfaces; Step 8 severity-adaptive (sonnet default, opus escalation for Critical/redesign-scope/security-payment items, escalation logged); coordinator-model note added (run sprints from the most capable session tier; model fields are relative tiers, re-map by role when the lineup shifts). NEW always-on token-usage log: coordinator writes {implementation_artifacts}/sprint-epic-<ID>-token-usage.md every sprint by default — per-spawn harness-reported rows (incl. retries and killed/degraded/stalled spawns), per-story totals, sprint-end step averages, waste %, and trim/bulk observations vs prior sprints; coordinator-only, never injected into agent prompts.

6.10.0.changelog: BMAD 6.10 support. Verified by diffing BMAD-METHOD tags v6.8.0..v6.10.0 directly. NO INTERFACE BREAKS: all nine invoked skills unchanged in name (/bmad-create-story, /bmad-dev-story, /bmad-code-review, /bmad-qa-generate-e2e-tests, /bmad-sprint-status, /bmad-correct-course, /bmad-advanced-elicitation, /bmad-quick-dev, /bmad-help); .claude/skills install target unchanged (platform-codes.yaml claude-code entry untouched — the +14 lines are new hermes-agent/CodeWhale platforms); all three explicit-path support files unchanged and co-located as before (bmad-dev-auto gains a SECOND compile-epic-context.md copy — harmless, the ${BMAD_SKILLS_ROOT} cascade keys on bmad-create-story/checklist.md); tools/installer/core/config.js byte-identical so _bmad/core/config.yaml + _bmad/bmm/config.yaml still generated (the four-layer TOML resolver already existed at 6.8 — no migration); bmad-dev-story ENTIRELY unchanged and code-review step-01-gather-context.md unchanged, so baseline_commit stamping/diff-base logic is identical and the 6.8 Step 7 File-List scope guard stays correct; story status vocabulary unchanged; methods.csv schema unchanged (+2 methods, renumber only — Step 2 selects by relevance not index); removals.txt adds only bmad-investigate and bmad-auto-setup. 6.9/6.10 breaking changes are all non-consumed surfaces (bmad-automator → bmad-loop opt-in module, bmad-investigate retired, bmad-create-architecture → bmad-architecture shim). FOUR CHANGES: (1) SUBAGENT STANDING AUTHORIZATION — 6.10 added an 'ask once now for the whole workflow run' subagent-permission line to bmad-create-story/SKILL.md AND bmad-code-review/SKILL.md; Steps 1 and 7 invoke those inside Task agents that cannot prompt a user, and Step 7 is already the pipeline's #1 stall source, so both prompts now grant that authorization up front and forbid BMAD's prompt-files-and-HALT fallback. (2) SEVERITY TAXONOMY REMAP (#2523) — 6.10 triage emits only low/medium/high (no `critical` band), discards subagent-assigned severity, reads call sites before rating, and drops the conservative tie-breaker; Step 8's opus-escalation trigger keyed on 'Critical severity' was dead code, so Steps 7/8 and Decision Point #4 now speak low/medium/high and the escalation is re-derived from blast-radius (new per-finding boolean returned by Step 7) + redesign-scope. Fewer items will route to Step 8 by design — explicit instruction not to compensate. (3) sprint-status.yaml `action_items:` (6.9, retrospective-owned, separate status enum) — Step 10's surgical flip already preserves it; now stated explicitly so the coordinator doesn't strip it as schema drift or fail it against the story-status enum, and the close-out reconcile's new 'Open Action Items' block is documented as expected output. (4) STEP 7 TOKEN BASELINE BREAK — deletion audit folded into Edge Case Hunter (#2525) plus a named-set generalization pass at a measured +19% tokens/run (#2524); token-usage log now warns that pre-6.10 Step 7 averages are not comparable so the next tuning pass doesn't misread a spec change as regression. Stale 'BMAD 6.4' labels in live instructions generalized to '6.4+'. python3 still works (uv run becomes required in v7 — that is the upgrade that will force real work). Hotfix: version label bumped to 6.10.0 only.
